<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 127.0997, which corresponds to [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral mass of ≈126.099 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈8 % M+1 intensity) matches a molecule containing about eight carbon atoms. The formula C₈H₁₄O has an exact monoisotopic mass of 126.1045 Da, within typical instrument error, and its predicted isotopic distribution (≈8–9 % M+1, ≈0.3–0.5 % M+2) matches the observed spectrum. No other heteroatoms are indicated. Therefore the molecular formula is C₈H₁₄O.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O</final_answer>
